answer.text:
Lisbon Airport to Sintra: transfer options, time and cost

Getting from Lisbon Portela airport (LIS) to Sintra

Taxi or rideshare
About 45 to 60 minutes, depending on traffic. Roughly €45 to €60 each way. Taxis wait at the official rank outside arrivals. Rideshare pickups are at the designated meeting point in the parking area.

Public transport
Cheaper but slower. Take the metro from the airport to Alameda or Saldanha, then the CP train from Rossio to Sintra. Total time about 1 hour 15 minutes. The metro and train are paid with a rechargeable Viva Viagem card or contactless bank card.

Welcome Sintra bus
Direct bus from the airport arrivals hall (Terminal 1) to Sintra town centre. About 1 hour 10 minutes. Buses run roughly every 30 minutes from 6:00 AM to 11:00 PM. One-way fare €12, paid by card on board.

Tips
Traffic into Sintra is heaviest on weekend afternoons. Book a private transfer ahead of time if you are arriving late at night.
